zh: **删除对话不再带走它的用量**：面板的账此前每趟都从现存的会话日志重算，日志一删，那个会话的日子就从「全部」里消失。现在本地的这本账记在插件自己的目录里，日志已不在的会话照旧留着它结算过的日子，面板继续给出这些日子的 tokens、模型排行与小时分布；早先留在折算缓存里的日子在首次读取时迁移过来。
en: **Deleting a conversation no longer takes its usage with it**: the panel's own account was folded again from the stored logs on every pass, so a log deleted took that session's days out of the all-time figures. The local account now lives in the plugin's own directory, and a session whose log is gone keeps the days it settled on — the panel still gives those days' tokens, its model ranking and its hour histogram. The days an earlier build kept in its fold cache are migrated on the first read.
